content.title: Graco® Recall
content.text: Car Seats 2016 Milestone Car Seat Recall Potential Problem: Over the past 60 years, safety has been and will continue to be our priority at Graco. As part of Graco’s continuous process of reviewing the quality of its products, Graco has discovered and reported an administrative error on the on-product labels located on approximately 6,000 Graco Milestone All-in-One car seats manufactured and sold between July 2015 and October 2015. While it does not affect the dynamic performance of the Milestone car seat if used in accordance with the owner’s manual, the on-product labels do not include the phrase “secure this child restraint with the vehicle's child restraint anchorage system, if available, or with a vehicle belt,” which is required by the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA). Injuries Reported: 0 Number of Units Affected: 6,382 Dates Produced: July 9, 2015 through October 9, 2015 MSRP: $299.99 Models Affected: Milestone Model Numbers Affected Date Range 1910130 July 9, 2015 through October 9, 2015 1923980 August 4, 2015 1926538 September 12, 2015 1926539 August 17, 2015 Solution: Graco is recalling these affected car seats and providing owners with free replacement labels (in English and Spanish) that can be applied directly to the car seat. Rest assured this does not affect the safety and dynamic performance of the car seat if used in accordance of the owner’s manual and consumers can continue to use their car seat without hesitation while waiting for the replacement labels. To verify if a car seat is included in this recall and order replacement labels, consumers should contact our consumer services team at 1-800-345-4109 (Monday through Friday from 9 am to 5 pm ET). Click here to see if you are affected, or contact Graco toll-free at 800-345-4109 Monday - Friday from 8 am to 5 pm EST. The model number and date of manufacture can be found on the white label located on the bottom of the car seat. We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may cause our consumers and appreciate their understanding. If you have any questions, please visit our Contact Form or email us at gracoconsumercare@newellco.com. We can also be reached by phone at 1-800-345-4109 between 8 a.m. – 5 p.m. ET, Monday through Friday.
